svg.title: How the home setup fits together
svg.desc: The router connects the Internet to the home network and its DHCP tells every device to use the Pi Zero (192.168.1.2) for DNS. Three devices hang off the router: the Pi Zero running Pi-hole (DNS on port 53, dashboard at /admin), the Pi 5 running LibreELEC with Kodi and RetroPlayer (web remote on port 8080) and Jellyfin in Docker (port 8096), and the NAS with SMB/NFS shares for movies, shows, music and games. The Pi 5 drives the TV over HDMI0 and talks to the gamepads over Bluetooth or USB.

g.text: IP addresses are the guide’s examples
